en.body:
Updated August 19, 2026

Tulum festival season returns around New Year with events spread across jungle venues, beach clubs, cenotes and other locations around town. Rather than one festival taking over the city, the season is made up of separate events, artist showcases and multi-date series that run from late December into January.

This is our live guide to the 2027 Tulum festival season. We update it as dates, lineups, venues, tickets and set times are officially announced, so you can keep one page bookmarked rather than trying to piece together information from old festival calendars.

The season is still taking shape. Day Zero has already released its full 2027 lineup, Solomun has confirmed his return to Tehmplo, Zamna has opened its 2027 Multipass, and a new seven-date daytime series called 7 Realms will run across Tulum from January 1–13. More announcements are expected as the season gets closer.

7 Realms — January 1–13, 2027

7 Realms is a new festival created by Tulum Bible, taking place across seven dates from January 1 to 13, 2027. Every other day, the festival moves to a different location around Tulum, with each realm built around its own setting, music and collaborators.

We created 7 Realms to bring more of Tulum into festival season. Instead of keeping everything inside one festival ground, the series will connect people with local venues, hotels and businesses across town while giving each event a completely different setting. All seven events take place during the day, leaving the nights open for the rest of Tulum’s January calendar.

There is also a points system running alongside the festival. People can earn points by inviting friends, completing challenges, checking in at participating local venues and attending the realms themselves. Those points can be used for rewards including discounted and free tickets, drinks and upgrades, while the leaderboard gives participants the chance to win additional prizes.

The seven dates are January 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11 and 13, but the realms, locations, collaborators and lineups will be revealed gradually rather than all at once.

If you want to see each realm as it is announced — and start taking part before tickets go on sale — sign up at 7realms.mx.

Dates: January 1–13, 2027
Format: Seven daytime events across seven locations
Locations: Revealed one by one
Lineups: Revealed one by one
Tickets: Coming later
Sign-up: Open now at 7realms.mx
en.bodyIntro:
Zamna Festival Tulum 2027

Zamna Tulum is confirmed for the 2027 season, but this is the section that will change the most over the next few months.

At the moment, Zamna has opened sales for its Tulum 2027 Multipass, while the individual artist showcases and festival nights have not yet been officially published. The pass provides codes that can be exchanged for tickets to three Zamna events once the calendar is available.

That distinction matters because Zamna is not normally one continuous festival where a single ticket gives you access to every night. It is a season of individual events at the same large jungle venue. In 2026, for example, its programme included separate dates for David Guetta, ANTS, RÜFÜS DU SOL, No Art, Keinemusik, Adriatique's X, Mayan Warrior and other artists and brands. Those were 2026 events and should not be treated as confirmed for 2027.

Zamna is also heading into its tenth-anniversary year in 2027, and its official channels have begun promoting Tulum as the start of that anniversary season.

For now, the important thing is simple:

Zamna Tulum 2027 is happening. The individual nights and lineups are still TBA.

We will add every confirmed Zamna date here as soon as the official programme starts to come out.

Location: Zamna Tulum
2027 programme: TBA
Multipass: On sale
Individual tickets: TBA
Lineups: TBA

Zamna Tulum 2027 dates

No individual 2027 events have been officially announced yet.

This section will become the main Zamna calendar once releases begin.

More Tulum festival announcements are coming

If the calendar looks lighter than previous years right now, that is because it is still August 2026.

Day Zero is unusually far ahead with its full lineup already announced. Zamna, meanwhile, has confirmed its Tulum return and started selling Multipasses but has not yet revealed the individual 2027 programme. Tehmplo currently lists Solomun as its first major January announcement.

We would rather leave a date blank than publish rumours as confirmed events.

As new festivals, venue programmes and artist showcases are officially announced, we will add them to this page in date order.

When is festival season in Tulum?

The main electronic music season generally sits around New Year and the first half of January. Your previous seasons have seen large event calendars develop across Zamna, Tehmplo, Day Zero and other venues during that period.

For 2027, confirmed events currently run from January 1 through January 13, with Zamna also preparing its New Year season.

The result is not really one festival week. It is closer to two weeks where several independent programmes overlap.

That is worth remembering when choosing dates. If music is an important part of the trip, look at the full calendar before booking flights rather than travelling for one event alone.

Where should you stay during Tulum festival season?

There is no single best area because the events do not all happen in the same place.

Tulum town and Aldea Zama give you a useful middle ground for restaurants, villas and getting around. The Hotel Zone makes sense if most of your plans are around the beach, but festival traffic can make the road slower at busy times.

If several jungle events are part of your trip, think about transportation as much as the hotel itself. A beautiful hotel is less useful if every event means a difficult trip across town.

For groups, a villa can also make sense because everyone can stay together and makes scheduled transport considerably easier.

Getting to Tulum festivals

For the larger January events, arranging transport before the night is usually easier than trying to work it out when thousands of people are leaving at the same time.

Different venues sit in very different parts of Tulum. Tehmplo is on the Tulum–Boca Paila road at Km 5.5, while Day Zero takes place in a separate jungle setting and Zamna has its own festival grounds.

If you have several festival dates planned, a driver for the night or for the full stay can be easier than arranging each journey separately.

Tulum Bible can help arrange private transportation around your event schedule.

Tulum festival tickets and tables

The safest option is always to buy festival tickets through the official organiser or its authorised ticketing partner.

We also list confirmed Tulum events on our event calendar, where you can check dates, venue information and available booking options.

For events that offer tables or other group packages, Tulum Bible can also help send the reservation request to the relevant venue or organiser.

Do not assume a ticket advertised on a resale site reflects the original price, particularly before the official release has started.

How past seasons have looked

Tulum's festival formula has been stable for years: a dense core from New Year's Eve to mid-January around Zamna and Day Zero, with beach-club series carrying the rest of the winter. For a feel of how a season plays out night by night, read our Zamna season recap and the story of Mayan Warrior's move to Zamna. The dates and lineups above always reflect the current season.

Planning your festival trip

You do not need to build the entire trip around late nights.

With daytime events, jungle festivals, beach clubs, restaurants, cenotes and the rest of Tulum running at the same time, the best festival trips usually leave some space between the major dates.

Use our Tulum Events calendar for individual parties and set times as they are announced, or message us if you want help putting together transportation, reservations and the rest of the trip.

Tulum, on your terms.

es.body:
Actualizado el 19 de agosto de 2026

La temporada de festivales de Tulum vuelve en torno a Año Nuevo con eventos repartidos por locales en la selva, beach clubs, cenotes y otros lugares de la ciudad. En lugar de que un único festival acapare toda la ciudad, la temporada se compone de eventos independientes, actuaciones de artistas y ciclos de varias fechas que se extienden desde finales de diciembre hasta enero.

Esta es nuestra guía en directo de la temporada de festivales de Tulum de 2027. La actualizamos a medida que se anuncian oficialmente las fechas, los carteles, los recintos, las entradas y los horarios de las actuaciones, para que puedas guardar esta página en tus favoritos en lugar de tener que recopilar información de antiguos calendarios de festivales.

La temporada aún se está perfilando. Day Zero ya ha dado a conocer su cartel completo para 2027, Solomun ha confirmado su regreso a Tehmplo, Zamna ha puesto a la venta su Multipass 2027 y una nueva serie diurna de siete fechas llamada «7 Realms» se celebrará en Tulum del 1 al 13 de enero. Se esperan más anuncios a medida que se acerque la temporada.

7 Realms — Del 1 al 13 de enero de 2027

«7 Realms» es un nuevo festival creado por Tulum Bible, que tendrá lugar en siete fechas entre el 1 y el 13 de enero de 2027. Cada dos días, el festival se traslada a un lugar diferente de Tulum, y cada «reino» se articula en torno a su propio escenario, música y colaboradores.

Creamos 7 Realms para integrar más de Tulum en la temporada de festivales. En lugar de concentrarlo todo en un único recinto, la serie conectará a la gente con locales, hoteles y negocios de toda la ciudad, al tiempo que dotará a cada evento de un entorno completamente diferente. Los siete eventos tendrán lugar durante el día, dejando las noches libres para el resto del calendario de enero de Tulum.

Además, hay un sistema de puntos que funciona en paralelo al festival. Los participantes pueden ganar puntos invitando a amigos, completando retos, registrándose en los locales participantes y asistiendo a los propios «Reinos». Esos puntos se pueden canjear por recompensas, como entradas con descuento o gratuitas, bebidas y mejoras, mientras que la clasificación ofrece a los participantes la oportunidad de ganar premios adicionales.

Las siete fechas son el 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11 y 13 de enero, pero los «reinos», las ubicaciones, los colaboradores y los carteles se irán revelando poco a poco, en lugar de todos a la vez.

Si quieres conocer cada «realm» a medida que se anuncie —y empezar a participar antes de que salgan a la venta las entradas—, regístrate en 7realms.mx.

Fechas: del 1 al 13 de enero de 2027
Formato: Siete eventos diurnos en siete ubicaciones
Ubicaciones: Se revelarán una a una
Carteles: Se revelarán uno a uno
Entradas: Próximamente
Inscripciones: Ya abiertas en 7realms.mx
es.bodyIntro:
Festival Zamna de Tulum 2027

El Zamna Tulum está confirmado para la temporada 2027, pero esta es la sección que más cambios sufrirá en los próximos meses.

Por el momento, Zamna ha puesto a la venta su Multipass Tulum 2027, mientras que las actuaciones de artistas individuales y las noches del festival aún no se han publicado oficialmente. El pase proporciona códigos que se pueden canjear por entradas para tres eventos de Zamna una vez que el calendario esté disponible.

Esta distinción es importante porque Zamna no suele ser un festival continuo en el que una sola entrada te dé acceso a todas las noches. Se trata de una temporada de eventos individuales que tienen lugar en el mismo gran recinto en la selva. En 2026, por ejemplo, su programa incluyó fechas independientes para David Guetta, ANTS, RÜFÜS DU SOL, No Art, Keinemusik, Adriatique’s X, Mayan Warrior y otros artistas y marcas. Esos fueron los eventos de 2026 y no deben considerarse confirmados para 2027.

Zamna también se encamina hacia su décimo aniversario en 2027, y sus canales oficiales han comenzado a promocionar Tulum como el punto de partida de esa temporada de aniversario.

Por ahora, lo importante es sencillo:

Zamna Tulum 2027 se celebrará. Las noches concretas y los carteles aún están por confirmar.

Añadiremos aquí todas las fechas confirmadas de Zamna tan pronto como empiece a publicarse el programa oficial.

Lugar: Zamna Tulum
Programa de 2027: por confirmar
Pase múltiple: A la venta
Entradas individuales: por confirmar
Cartel: por confirmar

Fechas de Zamna Tulum 2027

Aún no se ha anunciado oficialmente ningún evento individual para 2027.

Esta sección se convertirá en el calendario principal de Zamna en cuanto se empiecen a publicar las novedades.

Próximamente habrá más anuncios sobre el festival de Tulum

Si el calendario parece más escaso que en años anteriores en este momento, es porque aún estamos en agosto de 2026.

Day Zero se celebra inusualmente pronto y ya ha anunciado su cartel completo. Zamna, por su parte, ha confirmado su regreso a Tulum y ha comenzado a vender Multipasses, pero aún no ha revelado el programa concreto para 2027. Tehmplo incluye actualmente a Solomun como su primer gran anuncio para enero.

Preferimos dejar una fecha en blanco antes que publicar rumores como si fueran eventos confirmados.

A medida que se anuncien oficialmente nuevos festivales, programas de recintos y actuaciones de artistas, los iremos añadiendo a esta página por orden cronológico.

¿Cuándo es la temporada de festivales en Tulum?

La temporada principal de música electrónica suele concentrarse en torno a Año Nuevo y la primera quincena de enero. En temporadas anteriores se han desarrollado amplios calendarios de eventos en Zamna, Tehmplo, Day Zero y otras salas durante ese periodo.

Para 2027, los eventos confirmados se extienden actualmente del 1 al 13 de enero, y Zamna también está preparando su temporada de Año Nuevo.

El resultado no es realmente una sola semana de festivales, sino más bien dos semanas en las que se solapan varios programas independientes.

Vale la pena tenerlo en cuenta a la hora de elegir las fechas. Si la música es una parte importante del viaje, consulta el calendario completo antes de reservar los vuelos, en lugar de viajar solo para asistir a un evento concreto.

¿Dónde alojarse durante la temporada de festivales de Tulum?

No hay una zona que sea la mejor, ya que los eventos no se celebran todos en el mismo lugar.

La localidad de Tulum y Aldea Zama te ofrecen un punto intermedio muy práctico en cuanto a restaurantes, villas y desplazamientos. La Zona Hotelera es una buena opción si la mayoría de tus planes giran en torno a la playa, pero el tráfico de los festivales puede ralentizar el tráfico en las horas punta.

Si tu viaje incluye varios eventos en la selva, ten en cuenta el transporte tanto como el propio hotel. Un hotel precioso no sirve de mucho si cada evento implica un viaje complicado por toda la ciudad.

Para grupos, una villa también puede ser una buena opción, ya que permite que todos se alojen juntos y facilita considerablemente el transporte programado.

Cómo llegar a los festivales de Tulum

Para los eventos más grandes de enero, suele ser más fácil organizar el transporte antes de la noche que intentar resolverlo cuando miles de personas se marchan al mismo tiempo.

Los distintos recintos se encuentran en zonas muy diferentes de Tulum. Tehmplo está en la carretera de Tulum a Boca Paila, en el km 5,5, mientras que Day Zero tiene lugar en un entorno selvático aparte y Zamna cuenta con su propio recinto festivo.

Si tienes varias fechas de festivales previstas, contratar a un conductor para la noche o para toda la estancia puede resultar más sencillo que organizar cada trayecto por separado.

Tulum Bible puede ayudarte a organizar el transporte privado en función de tu programa de eventos.

Entradas y mesas para los festivales de Tulum

La opción más segura es siempre comprar las entradas para los festivales a través del organizador oficial o de su socio autorizado de venta de entradas.

También incluimos los eventos confirmados de Tulum en nuestro calendario de eventos, donde puedes consultar las fechas, la información sobre el recinto y las opciones de reserva disponibles.

Para los eventos que ofrecen mesas u otros paquetes para grupos, Tulum Bible también puede ayudarte a enviar la solicitud de reserva al recinto u organizador correspondiente.

No des por sentado que una entrada anunciada en una web de reventa refleje el precio original, sobre todo antes de que haya comenzado la venta oficial.

Cómo han sido las temporadas anteriores

La fórmula de los festivales de Tulum se ha mantenido estable durante años: un núcleo denso desde Nochevieja hasta mediados de enero en torno a Zamna y Day Zero, con una serie de eventos en clubes de playa que completan el resto del invierno. Para hacerte una idea de cómo se desarrolla una temporada noche a noche, lee nuestro resumen de la temporada de Zamna y la historia del traslado de Mayan Warrior a Zamna. Las fechas y los carteles que aparecen arriba siempre reflejan la temporada actual.

Planifica tu viaje a los festivales

No hace falta que organices todo el viaje en torno a las noches de fiesta.

Con eventos diurnos, festivales en la selva, beach clubs, restaurantes, cenotes y el resto de Tulum en plena actividad al mismo tiempo, los mejores viajes a los festivales suelen dejar algo de margen entre las fechas principales.

Utiliza nuestro calendario de eventos de Tulum para ver las fiestas individuales y los horarios a medida que se anuncian, o envíanos un mensaje si necesitas ayuda para organizar el transporte, las reservas y el resto del viaje.

Tulum, a tu manera.

es.body:
Confirmed for New Year's Eve 2026 → 2027

New Year's Eve in Tulum is not one big city-wide celebration. December 31 is spread across beach clubs, restaurants, jungle venues and hotels, with everything from long dinners and bottle-service tables to parties that continue well after midnight.

This is our live guide to New Year's Eve 2027 in Tulum, taking place on Thursday, December 31, 2026. We update it as venues announce their menus, lineups, ticket prices and table packages.

It is still early in the season. Gitano has already opened reservations for both its Beach and Jungle celebrations, Papaya Playa Project has confirmed its annual beachfront NYE event, and several of Tulum's usual December 31 venues have yet to announce their plans.

Which Tulum New Year's Eve should you choose?

The best option depends less on which venue is “the biggest” and more on what you actually want to do before midnight.

If you want dinner followed by dancing without changing venues, Gitano Jungle is already one of the clearest confirmed options.

If you want New Year's Eve directly on the beach, Gitano Beach and Mia, Bagatelle are great options but we would need to wait for them to confirm their plans.

If you are waiting for a large electronic music event, it is worth waiting a little longer before buying anything. Zamna has confirmed its 2027 season but has not yet announced an individual December 31 lineup.

More restaurant dinners, hotel celebrations and beach-club events normally appear as the season gets closer, so this page will grow considerably over the next few months.
es.bodyIntro:
What about Zamna on New Year's Eve?

Zamna is confirmed to return to Tulum for its 2027 festival season and has already released a three-event Multipass. The official Multipass listing is dated December 31, 2026.

However, that is not the same thing as an announced Zamna New Year's Eve event.

As of August 19, Zamna's official Tulum event calendar only lists the 2027 Multipass. There is no individual December 31 artist, showcase or lineup published yet.

Last season Zamna welcomed 2026 with MRAK on December 31, but that was the 2025/26 programme and should not be assumed to be returning.

If Zamna announces an NYE event for 2027, it will be added here.

More New Year's Eve announcements are coming

A lot of the Tulum NYE calendar is still missing, and that is normal this far from December.

Previous Tulum Bible guides have included celebrations from venues such as Vagalume, Ahau, Bagatelle, Mía, Ilios and others, but their previous events should not be treated as confirmation that they will run the same format this year.

Instead of creating placeholder events based on what happened last season, we will update this guide as each venue releases its actual 2027 plans.

So if the list looks short today, check back.

Dinner or party?

One of the biggest differences between Tulum NYE options is when the night actually starts.

Dinner + party

A lot of beach clubs and restaurants sell a complete package beginning around 7–9 PM. You get your table for dinner, stay through midnight and then continue at the same venue.

This is usually the easiest setup for groups because you avoid trying to move around the Hotel Zone close to midnight.

Gitano Jungle and Gitano Beach already have versions of this format confirmed for 2027.

Party only

If you already have dinner plans, some venues offer general admission later in the evening.

Gitano's current party-only entries begin at 10 PM.

Table or bottle service

For larger groups, reserving a table can make more sense than buying individual entry tickets, especially if the group expects to order bottles anyway.

Just check what is actually included. Some packages are a fixed price, others include a food or beverage credit, and gratuity may be additional.

New Year's Eve dinner in Tulum

You do not need to go to a festival to have a good December 31 in Tulum.

Many of the better restaurants prepare fixed New Year's Eve menus with later seatings designed to carry the table through midnight.

These dinners usually start appearing later in the year, so we will add the best confirmed options here rather than listing restaurants that have not published their 2027 programme yet.

When comparing dinners, look at:

  • whether the price is only dinner or also includes drinks;

  • whether you keep your table after midnight;

  • whether entry to the party is included;

  • whether there is a service charge;

  • where your table is located; and

  • what time the reservation ends.

A cheaper dinner can become less useful if you then need another ticket and another journey to get to the party.

New Year's Day: 7 Realms begins January 1

New Year's Eve is also the beginning of the wider January season.

On January 1, 2027, the first date of 7 Realms takes place, beginning a seven-event daytime series created by Tulum Bible and running every other day through January 13.

We created 7 Realms to connect festival season with more of Tulum itself. Each event moves to a different location, while the wider project works with local venues, hotels and businesses around town.

There is also a points system where people can earn rewards through invites, challenges, participating venues and festival attendance, with free and discounted tickets and other prizes available along the way.

If you are coming to Tulum for New Year's and want to see what begins on January 1, sign up to 7 Realms before the reveals start.

Sign up at 7realms.mx

New Year's Eve traffic in Tulum

This is one part of the night worth planning before you arrive.

The beach road becomes particularly busy on December 31, and many NYE venues start dinner at a similar time.

If your reservation is in the Hotel Zone, do not plan around the amount of time the same journey takes on a normal evening.

Gitano's own NYE information advises guests to account for New Year's traffic, and previous venue listings do the same.

For groups, pre-arranged transportation is usually easier than trying to find several cars later in the evening.

Tulum Bible can help arrange a pickup around your dinner or party booking.

Where should you stay for New Year's Eve?

Your NYE plan should influence where you stay.

If your main reservation is at Gitano, Papaya Playa Project or another Hotel Zone venue, staying near the beach can remove a lot of travel from the night.

If New Year's Eve is only the start of a longer festival trip, Aldea Zama, La Veleta or Tulum town may give you more flexibility for the rest of the stay.

For larger groups, a villa also makes it easier to have everyone leave together and arrange one transport schedule.

I would choose the stay around the whole trip, not just where you plan to be at midnight.

When should you book Tulum New Year's Eve?

For a group that already knows where it wants to go, earlier is generally better.

NYE is different from an ordinary night because restaurants work with limited dinner seatings and table areas. Once the specific section you want is full, buying a more expensive ticket later does not necessarily get it back.

On the other hand, if you are mainly waiting for the electronic music lineups, it may make sense to wait for the next round of announcements instead of buying the first available party simply because it is already on sale.

We will keep the confirmed list at the top of this guide updated as that happens.

Planning New Year's Eve in Tulum

There is no single correct way to spend December 31 here.

You can have dinner by the beach and stay for midnight, start with a long dinner in the jungle, wait for one of the larger electronic events, or keep New Year's Eve relatively simple and save the bigger nights for the January festival calendar.

The useful part is deciding before December 31 how dinner, the party and transport fit together.

Browse our Tulum Events calendar for the latest confirmed announcements, or message Tulum Bible if you want help choosing between the options and arranging tables or transportation.

Tulum, on your terms.
